summary: Admission denial for MBBS to person with disabilities; disability assessment (58% locomotor/speech); NMC Guidelines requiring intact hands; functional assessment vs mechanical interpretation; Omkar Ramchandra Gond precedent mandating revision; reasonable accommodation under RPwD Act; UN Convention principles; AIIMS Medical Board split opinion; dismissal of writ petition improper; admission directed with clinical accommodations.
legal_provisions_cited: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
Graduate Medical Education Regulations (Amendment), 2019 Appendix H-1
Omkar Ramchandra Gond v. Union of India & Ors., 2024 SCC OnLine SC 2860
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; admission to Government Medical College, Sirohi directed against PwD (OBC) seat with necessary accommodations.
